scenario: Community search over user-generated posts, questions and comments. Priorities are relevance, click-through rate, and the serving cost of semantic matching, query understanding, retrieval and ranking. This edition contains only official vLLM engineering posts. Web supplements account for 100% of selections, so source diversity falls short. Supplements use the skill-authorized 90-day window; each card retains its publication date.

papers.title: Push-Based KV Transfer to Improve TTFT and TPOT for Disaggregated Inference in vLLM
papers.summary: A push-based NIXL connector overlaps destination allocation with prefill and moves transfer setup off the decode loop. In the specified Qwen3-32B 1P1D test on EC2 P5en with EFA, TTFT improves by up to about 3× over pull mode.
papers.key_insight: Transfer ownership and setup placement matter alongside bandwidth. Overlap preparation with prefill and keep coordination off the token-generation critical path.

papers.title: Improve TTFT for Multi-Turn Agentic Workloads with Bi-Directional KV Transfer in vLLM
papers.summary: Bidirectional KV transfer lets prefill nodes reuse state produced on decode nodes in earlier turns. In the specified GLM-5-FP8 1P1D multi-turn benchmark, TTFT improves by up to 3.3×.
papers.key_insight: Output-side cache becomes input-side state on the next turn. Session routing, retention and recompute controls determine whether that reuse survives in a deployed service.

papers.title: Adaptive Verification Without a Confidence Head
papers.summary: An online logistic estimator gives existing draft checkpoints acceptance probabilities without retraining a confidence head. For DeepSeek-V4-Flash with DSpark, the reported acceptance-classification AUC is 0.8336.
papers.key_insight: Use verification feedback already available during serving, but choose features that preserve the target sampling distribution. Conditioning trimming on the sampled token itself can introduce bias.

papers.title: Taking vLLM Apart: A Practical Guide to Disaggregated Serving
papers.summary: The guide separates prefill, decode and CPU text processing, then measures transfer costs. In its two-GPU test at 0.4 requests per second, p99 inter-token latency falls from 169 ms to 29 ms.
papers.key_insight: Disaggregation helps only when avoided interference outweighs transfer overhead. The slow-interconnect counterexample makes this a useful benchmark design guide.

papers.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on vLLM: 5x Agentic Throughput Since Day 0
papers.summary: vLLM combines compressed global state with bounded replay of recent sliding-window state and kernel fusion. The post reports 5× AgentX throughput compared with its day-zero implementation.
papers.key_insight: Decide what to cache by state type and recomputation cost. Bounded replay is approximate, so its quality checks belong with the performance result.

papers.title: Serving Reflection Beam on vLLM from Day 0
papers.summary: vLLM adds Beam support with fused execution and draft-model verification. Agent-assisted optimization makes batch-one decode 2.71× faster than the initial, largely unoptimized implementation.
papers.key_insight: A model integration is easier to assess when it includes a change-by-change performance breakdown. Preserve the initial-implementation baseline when interpreting the speedup.

papers.title: Reducing vLLM startup time with one uv flag
papers.summary: Precompiling Python bytecode during image construction avoids repeated runtime compilation. H100 benchmarks with images and models already local save about 18 seconds per startup.
papers.key_insight: Move repeatable preparation into the build. Account separately for image-size growth, first-pull cost and startup time on a node with cached layers.

papers.title: Announcing vllm-metal: Concurrent Serving on Apple Silicon
papers.authors: Ranran Haoran Zhang; Lik Xun Yuan; Chao Ju Chen; Eric Curtin; Michael Goin
papers.summary: vllm-metal brings continuous batching and paged KV management to Apple Silicon. In the reported mixed-length prompt test, batch wall time changes by only about 1% relative to the balanced-prompt batch.
papers.key_insight: Concurrent local serving needs scheduling and memory admission controls. Evaluate prompt-length skew alongside concurrency when testing a desktop assistant.

papers.title: Finish RL Training Faster: Bitwise-Consistent, High-Performance, Agent-Driven
papers.summary: Training forwards call inference kernels and remove batch-dependent numerical differences. The DeepSeek-V4-Flash experiment achieves bitwise-identical sampled-token log probabilities while retaining 91.3% of baseline rollout throughput.
papers.key_insight: Locate the first divergent operator when diagnosing unstable RL. The throughput measurement covers rollout; it does not establish an end-to-end training speedup.

papers.title: Hyper Optimizing Kimi K3 in vLLM: Moving Fast and Responsibly
papers.summary: Kimi K3 decode kernels fuse attention, expert execution and communication, with paths tuned to batch size. On sixteen GB300 GPUs at batch one, the reported controlled DSpark test delivers 1.73× the baseline decode throughput at the same synthetic acceptance length.
papers.key_insight: Optimize gaps between operators as well as individual kernels. The useful engineering lesson is to validate synchronization and long-context numerical behavior alongside latency.

run_notes: Discovery degraded: Semantic Scholar and DBLP were rate-limited; OpenReview returned API errors. Other paper feeds returned no candidates in the window.
Crawler blog dates were recovered from dated URLs in the merged pool; raw candidates are preserved.
The skill allows supplementary items up to 90 days old. Items outside the three-day crawler window retain their actual dates.
Hard deduplication reduced 24 candidates to 12; all 12 received five-dimension assessments and 10 were selected.
Source-diversity gap: all surviving selections are official vLLM engineering posts discovered through web search. The source share is 100%, above the 70% target.
Only infra was run. Per-track filtering and validation check existing reports from other tracks; the global resolver was skipped.
The infra automatic deep-reading quota is zero; no new deep readings were written.
PDF rendering was attempted but skipped because no renderer is installed.
Browser security policy rejected the local-file protocol. Visual inspection was not completed; deterministic generation and HTML/JSON consistency validation passed.
